timeline.title: A family recipe that found its home in Poblenou
timeline.description: The story of Copas y Encants began more than 30 years ago with a grandfather's recipe in Naples and now lives in Barcelona, around a shared table.
timeline.imageAlt: The story of Copas y Encants

entries.title: The grandfather's recipe
entries.description: Everything starts in Naples, with a family recipe passed down by the grandfather and the taste of Italian cooking made with patience.

entries.title: Arriving in Barcelona
entries.description: The idea travels to Barcelona with the wish to open a warm, authentic place faithful to that Neapolitan memory.

entries.title: The project takes shape
entries.description: After years of work and searching, the idea becomes real: a pizzeria restaurant with Italian soul and service in the dining room and on the terrace.

entries.title: Copas y Encants in Poblenou
entries.description: Copas y Encants becomes a restaurant in Poblenou, made for sharing pizzas, tapas and cocktails in a welcoming atmosphere.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.description: Can't find your answer? Call or write to us, we're happy to help.

items.question: Do I need to book a table?
items.answer: We recommend it, especially from Friday to Sunday. You can book from our website in under a minute or by phone.

items.question: Do you have vegetarian or gluten-free options?
items.answer: Yes. We offer several vegetarian pizzas and a gluten-free dough prepared in a separate area. Just let us know when booking.

items.question: Can I order takeaway?
items.answer: Of course. You can pick up your order at the restaurant; we bake your pizza just before you arrive so you enjoy it at its best.

items.question: Do you host private events?
items.answer: We reserve the venue for groups and celebrations. Write to us with the date and number of guests and we'll prepare a tailored proposal.

contact.title: Book your table by the fire
